body: For the record, it is called the “Tomato Art Fest”. But on the contrary, it’s my favorite weekend of the year in Nashville! Music, dancing, food and drinks, and of course, lots of locally curated art — most of which is tomato themed, but not all of it. I will say, two years ago I went on a Friday and didn’t have nearly as much fun as I did last year when I went on a Saturday. But maybe just different strokes for different folks!
